title: High-Protein Pumpkin Spice Cookie Dough
ingredients: 8 oz plain cottage cheese (I recommend full-fat)
1 tsp vanilla extract (or vanilla bean paste)
1 tsp pumpkin pie spice (+ more as desired)
3 tbsp coconut flour (as needed -- SEE NOTE*)
instructions: Add cottage cheese, pumpkin puree, maple syrup, vanilla, pumpkin pie spice & kosher salt to a blender and blend until smooth.

Pour blended cottage cheese & pumpkin mixture into a large bowl and add in the almond flour and protein powder. Stir to combine, then add in the coconut flour little by little, as needed, to get the cookie dough to your desired thickness.
Finally, stir in the chocolate chips. Enjoy right away, or let chill in the fridge.
